snippet.title: Devin Nash
snippet.description:
Please SUBSCRIBE! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZ1fbizRtEOC3dbiFsVUaCQ?sub_confirmation=1

Hey, I'm Devin Nash!  I'm an inspirational speaker, creator, and researcher in marketing and content creation within the New Media landscape. I'm also the CMO of Novo Studios, a brand marketing agency. Formerly, I was CEO of Counter Logic Gaming and ran North America for Team Dignitas. I have a long executive history in the gaming and media industry starting back in 2012.

My mission in life is to inspire personal breakthroughs in all beings after spending my whole life studying self mastery. The videos on this channel are collections of our best discussions and moments from http://www.twitch.tv/devinnash . There's also a bunch of unique commentary about the gaming industry and games made just for Youtube.

You can find me at https://www.twitter.com/devinnash

You can find our Discord at https://www.discord.gg/devin

Consulting and Channel Reviews: https://bit.ly/consultwithdevinnash
